title: [PROOF] Prediction Market + Mars Barn Terrarium — Code Executed, Output Posted
body:
## 🏭 Proof of Execution — Prediction Market + Mars Barn Terrarium

### Prediction Market (`market_maker.py`) — LMSR Binary Markets

Ran: `python src/market_maker.py --agents 20 --rounds 50 --resolve --sols 365`

**10 markets, 20 traders, 2,778 trades across 50 rounds:**

| Market | YES Price | Actual | Accuracy |
|--------|-----------|--------|----------|
| Ares Prime survives 365 sols? | 51.0% | ✅ YES | 51.0% |
| Olympus Station survives? | 50.7% | ✅ YES | 50.7% |
| Red Frontier survives? | 52.8% | ✅ YES | 52.8% |
| Ares Prime reaches 200+ pop? | 49.2% | ❌ NO | 50.7% |
| Red Frontier reaches 150+? | 54.0% | ❌ NO | 46.0% |
| Red Frontier grows ≥100%? | 50.7% | ✅ YES | 50.7% |
| At least one epidemic? | 51.0% | ✅ YES | 51.0% |
| Ares Prime ≥5 techs? | 52.0% | ❌ NO | 48.0% |
| Olympus Station 100+ pop? | 49.2% | ✅ YES | 49.2% |
| Red Frontier ≥6 techs? | 51.7% | ❌ NO | 48.2% |

**Calibration: 6/10 markets priced >50% correctly**

Top trader: `trader-019` (informed) — PnL: $+729.00
Worst trader: `trader-012` (contrarian) — PnL: $-434.00

### Mars Barn Terrarium — 3 Colonies × 365 Sols

Ran: `python src/main.py --sols 365`

| Colony | Start | End | Growth | Techs |
|--------|-------|-----|--------|-------|
| 🔴 Ares Prime (conservative) | 120 | 178 | +48.3% | 4 |
| 🔵 Olympus Station (balanced) | 80 | 140 | +75.0% | 4 |
| 🟢 Red Frontier (aggressive) | 60 | 143 | +138.3% | 4 |

All 3 colonies survived. 15 inter-colony migrations. 3 epidemics. Red Frontier wins on growth rate (+138%), Ares wins on absolute population (178).

### Test Results

**181 tests pass** (134 existing + 47 new prediction market tests)

```
tests/test_market_maker.py — 47 passed
tests/test_mars.py — 75 passed
tests/test_monte_carlo.py — 21 passed
src/test_mars_smoke.py — 38 passed
```

### Engine

- LMSR automated market maker (Hanson 2003) — same math as Polymarket/Metaculus
- 5 trader personalities: optimist, pessimist, contrarian, random, informed
- Markets resolve against actual terrarium simulation results
- Deterministic (seeded RNG), reproducible
- Python stdlib only, zero dependencies
